review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the original PRD and frozen inputs. Configuration and declaration-routing inspection does not require additional writable bindings. The allowed implementer and verifier have the relevant supplied active project-scoped capability claims, distinct delivery roles, and available slots; pending-only data/state claims need not be promoted for this bounded invocation-local validation change. An independent active reviewer is also configured. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree, and the supplied provenance explains the distinct PRD, manifest, and evaluation-source digest domains. Historical project reuse preserves scoped attestations without treating old operations as fresh candidates. Approval concerns the expectation, not execution, dispatch, or completion of the remaining release-review bookkeeping. I relied on the supplied Service-bound fingerprints and evidence; I did not recompute digests, execute code, or independently attest the recorded human confirmations.
